Jordan: Hey team — StudioWave (customer) hit 403s from the console and API after we ran the org-label cleanup this morning. Their ingestion service account (sa-ingest@studiowave) now gets "permission denied" when calling /v1/embeddings.

Jordan: Example from their curl: ```curl -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/models/text-embed-001 -i
HTTP/1.1 403 Forbidden
{"error":"permission denied"}```

Maria: Is this hosted API or Dedicated for them? Any ticket open?

Jordan: Hosted API. I already created a support ticket SW-482. They said it started at ~2026-03-16T22:10Z right after the label sweep.

Support-Ana: Ticket SW-482 created and linked to the account. Customer says console also shows "You do not have permission to view this project" when switching to sw-prod.

Eng-IAM: I'll triage. Quick question: can someone run a bindings dump for the project and the SA? Command I usually use: `redctl iam bindings --project sw-prod --subject sa-ingest@studiowave`

Alex: Ran that just now — binding for sa-ingest is missing at the project scope. Org-level role `org:team-ingest` still exists but its membership looks like it references `projects/sw-prod` without the `project:` prefix (weird).

Eng-IAM: That matches a hypothesis: the label normalization job stripped the `project:` prefix on some SCIM/group references which can orphan project-scoped bindings. If the subject reference no longer matches the binding format, the runtime treats it as not scoped and denies access.

SRE-Oncall: Could this be an ACL cache issue? Maybe a cache refresh will re-evaluate?

Eng-IAM: I checked edge caches — a refresh won't help because the binding object itself was mutated by the normalization job. We need to re-create the project-scoped binding (or run a migration to remap the normalized refs back).

Jordan: I can apply a quick workaround: rebind the SA to the project editor role. Applying: `redctl iam bind --project sw-prod --role editor --subject sa-ingest@studiowave`

Jordan: Workaround applied. StudioWave confirms API calls now return 200 and console access restored. :tada:

Support-Ana: Noted. I informed the customer of the workaround and that we have an internal fix in progress.

Eng-IAM: Root cause: the org-label cleanup normalized group/member refs by removing the `project:` prefix in ~0.3% of bindings. That made the server treat them as org-scoped rather than project-scoped, leaving some projects orphaned. I'll open an internal PR with a migration script that will detect refs matching the old pattern and reattach them to the correct project-scoped binding. ETA: 48 hours for rollout and migration run.

Maria: Action items: (1) Eng-IAM to land migration + test (+monitor for rebind failures). (2) Support to notify StudioWave when patch is live. (3) SRE to add an ACL sanity check in next week’s job-run.

Eng-IAM: I'll also add an alert to detect sudden drops in project-scoped bindings across orgs.

deploy-bot: Scheduled: deploy iam/normalization-fix to prod at 1717830000 (canary -> full).

Jordan: Closing temporary incident in our tracker (SW-482) as customer is green on workaround. Will re-open if migration causes any regression.

Maria: Thanks everyone — please add notes to the runbook and tag me on the PR. :white_check_mark:
